title: SIM: Subspace Interaction-based Method for Token-Level Text Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.08200v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Token-level text anomaly detection, as an emerging trend of text anomaly detection, moves beyond coarse-grained document-level detection by localizing anomalous tokens within text. By providing fine-grained abnormality prediction, token-level text anomaly detection plays a critical role in various real-world applications, such as spam filtering and fake news detection. However, existing methods still rely on the global distance calculation for scoring, during which the local anomaly signals are severely diluted by numerous redundant normal feature dimensions. Moreover, pre-trained language models used in these methods inevitably smooth out surface anomalies, further limiting their effectiveness in token-level anomaly detection. To address these limitations, we propose a Subspace Interaction-based Method (SIM for short) for token-level text anomaly detection. translated_title: SIM：基于子空间交互的词元级文本异常检测方法
translated_abstract: 词元级文本异常检测作为文本异常检测的新兴趋势，超越了粗粒度的文档级检测，能够定位文本中的异常词元。通过提供细粒度的异常预测，词元级文本异常检测在垃圾邮件过滤和假新闻检测等各种现实应用中发挥着关键作用。然而，现有方法仍然依赖全局距离计算进行评分，在此过程中，局部异常信号会被大量冗余的正常特征维度严重稀释。此外，这些方法中使用的预训练语言模型不可避免地会平滑掉表层异常，进一步限制了它们在词元级异常检测中的有效性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种用于词元级文本异常检测的基于子空间交互的方法（简称SIM）。为防止局部信号被稀释，SIM采用基于子空间交互的异常……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了基于子空间交互的方法SIM，通过避免局部异常信号被冗余特征维度稀释以及克服预训练语言模型对表层异常的平滑效应，实现了更有效的词元级文本异常检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SIM, a Subspace Interaction-based Method that prevents local anomaly signal dilution by redundant feature dimensions and overcomes the surface anomaly smoothing of pre-trained language models, enabling more effective token-level text anomaly detection.
